# Vietnam Thermal Power Plant Reference Inventory (>30 MWe)

> **Methodology note**: This inventory is compiled from parametric knowledge of Vietnamese government documents (Power Development Plans, EVN/PVN/Vinacomin reports), IEA, GEM (Global Energy Monitor), and major project announcements up to my knowledge cutoff (early 2025). I cannot browse the internet or verify live URLs. All source citations reference the document type and issuer; URLs are provided where I have reliable knowledge of stable government/institutional links, but **must be independently verified**. Entries marked ⚠️ indicate uncertainty in one or more fields.

---

## Critical Notes & Caveats

### 1. PDP8 Uncertainty
Power Development Plan VIII (Decision 500/QĐ-TTg, May 2023) significantly restructured Vietnam's thermal pipeline. Many coal projects were **removed, converted to LNG, or deferred**. The plan is subject to ongoing revision and implementation decrees. Planned CODs for post-2025 projects should be treated as indicative only.

### 2. Coal Phase-Out Trajectory
Under PDP8 and Vietnam's COP26 net-zero by 2050 commitment, **no new coal plants are to be approved after 2030**, and existing coal plants are to be retired or converted by 2050. Several projects in "Planned" status may never be built.

### 3. LNG Infrastructure Dependency
All LNG-fired plants are contingent on **FSRU/LNG terminal development**. Key terminals include:
- **Cái Mép** (Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu) – serving Nhon Trach 3&4
- **Son My** (Bình Thuận) – serving Son My 1&2
- **Bạc Liêu** – FSRU proposed by Delta Offshore Energy
- **Long An** – proposed terminal

### 4. Domestic Gas Decline
The **Block B – Ô Môn** gas pipeline project (supplying O Mon 2, 3, 4) has been delayed for over a decade due to gas pricing disputes between PVN and EVN. Domestic gas supply from Nam Côn Sơn and PM3 fields is declining, increasing LNG dependency.

### 5. Capacity Figures
Nameplate capacity figures vary between sources (EVN annual reports, GEM tracker, MOIT documents). Where discrepancies exist, the GEM-GCPT/GGPT figure is generally used as it is most frequently updated. ⚠️ flags indicate known discrepancies.
